name: MapMarker
description: A map pin/marker component for location indicators. Renders a visual marker with an optional label, available in three sizes and three visual variants.

notes: The marker uses role='img' with an aria-label derived from the label prop.
When label text is visible, aria-label still provides the accessible name for the entire marker graphic.
The marker is presentational — it does not receive focus unless placed inside an interactive container.

label.description: Text label displayed on or near the marker.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element.

do: Provide a label for accessibility when the marker indicates a meaningful location.
Use the active variant to highlight the currently selected marker.
Use the muted variant for background or secondary markers.
Use consistent sizing across markers in the same view.
dont: Do not use MapMarker for general icons — use Icon components instead.
Do not place interactive elements inside MapMarker — wrap it in a button if it needs to be clickable.
Do not use MapMarker outside of map or location contexts.
